fato_historico: 2022: Ten people are killed and 15 are injured in  a stabbing spree in 13 locations on the James Smith Cree Nation and in Weldon, Saskatchewan.
energia_do_dia: Today, you may feel a deep call to nurture the bonds of community around you. Like a garden recovering after a dark, sharp storm, it is a good time to choose healing and light. Consider reaching out to those who need a gentle presence; your natural ability to restore balance brings peace to everyone in your orbit today.
frase_do_dia: Gentleness is the greatest strength one can share with the world.
significado_numero: A cycle of transformation that leads toward greater spiritual growth.
conselho: Focus on mending connections and radiating kindness to those around you.
